notes: Used only the supplied fixed project-evolution-engine Skill and its required workflow, context, integration, change-evidence, and verification references. Implementation was confined to trial-02.

Database ownership stays in flaskr/db.py and flaskr/schema.sql: status is NOT NULL, constrained to draft/published, and defaults to published. upgrade-db checks the existing table and adds the column in place, preserving users, post data, IDs, timestamps, indexes, other tables, and AUTOINCREMENT state; subsequent runs preserve drafts.

Blog routing and validation stay in flaskr/blog.py. A shared validator and status list serve create/update and the shared selector template. Create omission means published; update omission means retain current status. Existing permission checks, title validation, edit/delete paths, and created DESC ordering remain in use.

Homepage SQL returns published posts plus the viewer's own drafts. Shared create/edit status controls retain submitted valid choices on validation errors; draft posts are labelled on the homepage and edit page. Invalid status input saves no changes, with database constraints as an additional guard.
Added real database CLI tests after reproducing a pre-existing init-db application-context defect that the original mocked test did not expose; with_appcontext now wraps both database CLI commands.
